Name: Samwiich's Elliott Portraits and Sprites
Author: samwiich
Description:
[size=5][b]﻿
♡ Samwiich's Elliott Portraits and Sprites ♡[/b][/size]

[size=4]Gives Elliott a cuter look with custom portraits updated for 1.6, matching character sprites, and a custom shop icon!  

[/size][img]https://i.ibb.co/5xtYmJ8R/elliot-pic.png[/img]
[size=4]
[b]This mod includes: [/b]
- Custom portraits  
- Custom sprites  
- Updated purchasable Traveling Merchant Elliot Portrait 
- Fully compatible with Content Patcher  
[b]
Installation:[/b]
1. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Download and extract this mod into your Mods folder  [/size]
[size=5][b]
Planned Updates 🎉: 
[/b][/size]
[size=4]I'm actively working on expanding this mod to all the villagers and seasonal portraits and more!!

I am working on:[/size]

[size=4]-  [b]Seasonal outfits[/b] for All NPCs (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter)  [/size]
[size=4]-  [b]Custom portraits[/b] [b]and sprites[/b] for [b]all Romanceable Characters  [/b][/size]
[size=4]-  [b]Portraits and sprites[/b] for [b]Non-Romanceable Villagers  [/b][/size]
[size=4]-  Expansion mod support:  
[/size][size=4]- Stardew Valley Expanded [b](SVE) [/b][/size]
[size=4]- Ridgeside Village [b](RSV)[/b]
- Other Expansions / Mods[/size]
[size=4]- Support for Custom NPCs 
[/size]
[size=5][b]♡ Stay tuned and follow the mod for updates! ♡
[/b][/size]
[size=1]

[/size]
